name: SPF ELECTRIC
old_description: A Leading Provider of Electrical Materials for Manufacturers, Installers & Contractors.
about:
SPF Electric, LLC operates from Angleton, Texas, on the Gulf Coast. The company does not publish a founding year, but its own materials cite over 25 years of immersion in the electrical power sector and nearly two decades of experience. No individual founders are named in the source content, and ownership structure (family, veteran, woman-owned, etc.) is not disclosed.

The shop specializes in electrical manufacturing and fabrication, offering bus fabrication (precision cutting, bending, punching, and shearing of copper and aluminum bus bar, plus aluminum bus bar welding), switchgear fabrication (CNC cutting, vertical and horizontal press brakes, iron worker, welding, and stud welding), G10/GP03 component machining (barriers, bus supports, circuit breaker operating rods), relay panels and switchgear doors, and powder coating. All services — design, drafting, fabrication, powder coating, gasket installation, and hardware assembly — are performed in-house, which the company says enables quicker turnarounds.

SPF Electric serves industrial, petrochemical, and electrical testing markets, with a noted focus on the Texas Gulf Coast area. Customers include maintenance and engineering departments needing replacement or custom doors, panels, covers, and structural components for switchgear, motor control centers (MCCs), and transformers. The company also highlights reverse engineering of hundreds of such components.

The firm emphasizes that centralizing design, fabrication, and finishing under one roof reduces lead times and improves quality. It also promotes its reverse-engineering capability and extensive library of factory drawings for relays, lights, switches, latches, push buttons, and accessories as a way to solve challenges for modern maintenance and engineering teams.
